observations: forged: no trusted receiver result; mismatches=none.
lookalike: trusted lookalike-relay: SPF=pass, DKIM=pass, DMARC=pass; mismatches=from-not-expected.
limitations: Receiver trust is supplied out of band for this exercise; an Authentication-Results header or matching relay name alone is not proof.
SPF authorises a sending domain context; DMARC relates authenticated domains to From. Neither authenticates a person or guarantees harmless content.
Only decoded strict domain alignment is checked; no DNS, signature, ARC, relaxed alignment, attachment or URL-content analysis occurs.
